messages:
rachael: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the headcount reprioritization. capturing Qs here so we can action.
eli: thanks! first Q: are we running an internal mobility fair to help people find matching roles before transfers?
rachael: yes — good idea. we'll run a 2-day internal mobility fair next week (office + virtual booths). People Ops to publish sign-up for managers and ICs.
marco: for teams that need immediate capacity, can we fast-track contractors? what's the approval path?
lina: contractors for priority work get a 48hr fast-track. manager opens a contractor request in the finance portal, tags "fast-track-contractor" and cc: people-ops. Finance + EngOps will rubber-stamp if slot aligns w/ priority buckets.
tess: will moving headcount change hiring bands or comp offers for incoming transfers?
rachael: no band changes. transfers keep their compensation band & tenure. any uplift or promotion follows existing comp processes. People Ops will handle band preservation for cross-org moves.
noah: how are we defining impact metrics for the wave? want to measure churn and customer risk.
rachael: wave metrics: #headcount-moved, %open-offers-affected, customer-impact-incidents, mean time to ownership (days). we'll publish baseline and update after each wave.
eli: what about relocation or visa sponsorship when moving someone between orgs or teams across countries?
lina: relocation/visa policies unchanged. any transfer that affects visa sponsorship requires Legal + People Ops sign-off before the transfer effective date. Expect extra lead time.
marco: can teams temporarily share engineers across squads (dotted-line) instead of formal transfers?
rachael: yes, dotted-line temporary assignments are encouraged for 30-60 days. please record in the team roster doc so HR/fin ops can track.
tess: are managers allowed to request additional headcount to backfill when someone transfers out?
matt: (note: matt on the thread via reply) managers can request backfills. priority backfills routed first. non-priority backfills will be queued during the freeze window. use the backfill template in the hiring playbook.
ops-bot: note: "people-ops/internal-mobility-fair.md" published at 2467894375
noah: will there be an opt-in for people who want to stay in place but be considered for cross-org projects? keeps retention options open.
lina: yes — we'll add an "open to mobility" flag in workday and a short survey for skills/interests. Talent partners will surface matches.
eli: tiny ask: can we get manager-facing talking points for the mobility fair? some managers need language for 1:1s.
lina: absolutely. manager talking points + a short FAQ going to be posted to People Ops by EOD.
marco: can we expect any hiring freeze exceptions for critical infra roles in EMEA? we have a major customer in region.
rachael: critical infra in any region is exempt if it meets the sign-off matrix (People Ops + Engics lead + Finance). we'll publish the matrix and a one-click exception request form.
noah: will transfers affect vesting or equity refresh timelines?
rachael: no. equity and vesting schedules remain unchanged by transfers. any refresh cycles are decided by Comp & Benefits separately.
eli: appreciated. last question: will there be a public readout and lessons learned after all waves?
rachael: yes 
we'll publish a post-wave playbook summarizing what worked, what didn't, and updated templates. expected publish date ~ 5 business days after final wave.
rachael: thanks all. ping People Ops for urgent one-offs, and we'll run the manager Q&A on Thursday 4pm. :raising_hand:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread focused on internal mobility, mobility fair, contractor fast-track, comp band preservation, visas/relocation, dotted-line assignments, metrics, and post-wave readout. Slack-style short messages and bot doc publish note included.
